premise: Mouse wants to see the top of Tree; he climbs branch by branch, resting on each one with Acorn for company, and reaches the top just as the sun sets.
inspiration: Perseverance folk tales (the little engine pattern), turned: resting on every branch counts as climbing, and the view is shared.
lesson: Big climbs happen one rest at a time.

en-US.title: Mouse Climbs the Tree
en-US.text: Mouse {mouse:pulse} looked up. And up. Tree {tree:pulse} went all the way to the sky. [curious] What is it like at the top? asked Mouse. Come and see, said Tree. It is a long way, for a mouse. Acorn {acorn:hop} rolled over. I will come too! {sfx:scritch} Scritch-scratch, up the bark to the first branch. {mouse:hop} Mouse sat down. [sighs] Phew. Is that climbing? he asked. Resting on a branch counts, said Tree. Scritch-scratch, second branch. {mouse:hop} Rest. Acorn told a joke. Scritch-scratch, third branch. {mouse:hop} Rest. Squirrel {squirrel:fade-in} zipped past. Nearly there! Fourth branch. Fifth. His legs were tired. Even his whiskers were tired. [excited] But then the leaves opened up, and there was the sky, and the sun was going down, pink and gold. {sfx:breeze solo} [gasps] Oh, said Mouse. Look, Acorn. {mouse:glow} {acorn:glow} Tree held them both, very still. [softly] I climbed a whole tree, said Mouse. One rest at a time.

es-ES.title: Ratón sube al árbol
es-ES.text: Ratón {mouse:pulse} miró hacia arriba. Y más arriba. Árbol {tree:pulse} llegaba hasta el cielo. [curious] ¿Cómo es allí arriba?, preguntó Ratón. Sube y verás, dijo Árbol. Pero es un camino largo para un ratón. Bellota {acorn:hop} rodó hasta él. ¡Yo también voy! {sfx:scritch} Ras-ras, por la corteza hasta la primera rama. {mouse:hop} Ratón se sentó. [sighs] Uf. ¿Esto cuenta como escalar?, preguntó. Descansar en una rama cuenta, dijo Árbol. Ras-ras, segunda rama. {mouse:hop} Descanso. Bellota contó un chiste. Ras-ras, tercera rama. {mouse:hop} Descanso. Ardilla {squirrel:fade-in} pasó como un rayo. ¡Ya casi! Cuarta rama. Quinta. Ratón tenía las patas cansadas. Hasta los bigotes cansados. [excited] Pero entonces las hojas se abrieron, y allí estaba el cielo, y el sol se estaba poniendo, rosa y dorado. {sfx:breeze solo} [gasps] Oh, dijo Ratón. Mira, Bellota. {mouse:glow} {acorn:glow} Árbol los sostuvo a los dos, muy quieto. [softly] He subido un árbol entero, dijo Ratón. Descanso a descanso.

scritch.prompt: tiny claws scrabbling up rough tree bark, quick scritch-scratch climbing

breeze.prompt: a soft high breeze through the topmost leaves of a tall tree at sunset, airy and calm
